title: Forlorn Hovel · Scosglen
caption: Travel to the marked cellar at Scosglen’s eastern tip.

title: Graves · Kurast Docks
caption: The graves are just south of Kurast Docks.

title: Thanks emote · grave order
caption: Use Thanks at the middle, middle-left, then middle-right grave.

title: Kichuk · scroll location
caption: Clear the stronghold to reach the Uacax scroll marked here.

title: The Triumph of Lord Uacax
caption: The scroll is a clue; reading it is not confirmed as a spawn requirement.

title: Blood Lightning · Nahantu
caption: Find the elite southwest of Kichuk; you can approach from Ichorfall.

title: Samuk · Five Hills
caption: Use Samuk as your starting waypoint, then head east to statue 1.

title: The twelve bird statues
caption: Follow 1–12, then return to 1. Move right up to each statue.

title: Three Cordycepic Zombies
caption: The marked spawns are in the Field of Giants, north of Ichorfall.

title: Oka’bo Temple · Nahantu
caption: Travel southeast from Kurast Bazaar to the marked temple.

title: Oka’bo Temple · three braziers
caption: Offer one corrupted relic at each brazier near the entrance.

title: Forlorn Burrow · Nahantu
caption: Enter the marked cellar west of Kurast Bazaar with the Unusual Key.

title: Forlorn Burrow · hidden wall
caption: Break this wall with the Unusual Key, then follow the passage into the cow chamber.

title: Outcast’s Journal · Skartara
caption: Return to this nook north of Fool’s Quarry after changing sins.

title: Inside the journal chamber
caption: Read the journal here; this is also the destination for the Moo portal.

title: Crow · Ruins of Broken Reason
caption: Find the large crow east of the Xanderos waypoint.

title: Follow the crow
caption: Stay close and wait while it circles. Follow the player route shown on the map.

title: Temple of Life · brazier location
caption: Bring the Hierophant’s Skull to the marked brazier in Lycander.

title: Temple of Life · signal brazier
caption: Interact with this brazier to offer the skull.

title: Training Grounds · Temis
caption: Enter Temis’s Training Grounds to find the dummy.

title: Corrupted Amazons · Athalua
caption: Hunt around the observatory and equip each Amazon armor piece as it drops.

title: Vasha the Unbroken
caption: Keep all five Amazon armor pieces equipped for this fight.

title: Temple of Courage · brazier location
caption: Bring Mother’s Rose to this marked location.

title: Temple of Courage · signal brazier
caption: Interact with this brazier to offer the rose.

title: Ballistas · Athalua
caption: After burning Pride and reading the journal, destroy a ballista here.

title: Idyllic Reach · Philios
caption: Take the Amazonian Bolt to this cellar.

title: Antia’s Flame · brazier location
caption: Bring Father’s Chains to the marked brazier in Philios.

title: Antia’s Flame · signal brazier
caption: Interact with this brazier to offer the chains.

title: Creaking Hulls · Hawezar
caption: Travel to the end of the path at the Temple of the Deathspeaker.

title: Fish from the very tip
caption: Use this exact fishing position to retrieve the coffin.

title: Outcast’s Boat · eastern Philios
caption: Carry the Torn Page and use the marked boat to sail to Scylara.

title: Vivid Whimsy · Scylara
caption: Fish in the rainbow pool beside the horse skeleton near the dock.

title: Holy Cedar Tablets · Kyovashad
caption: Return to the tablets at Kyovashad’s entrance to inscribe and burn Moo.

title: Moo portal · journal chamber
caption: After burning Moo, return here to enter the secret cow level.

title: Behind the wall · jump point
caption: After breaking the wall, use the Jump prompt to enter the hidden passage.

title: Forlorn Burrow · hidden passage
caption: Cross the gap and follow the passage to the cow chamber.
